subtitle: PonyLife operates in the open: clear boundaries, verifiable infrastructure, and versioned changes.
principles: Clear roles and boundaries (Creators, Promoters, Collectors, Platform)
Creators retain ownership; the platform coordinates participation and delegated commercialization rights
No guarantees: outcomes are uncertain and emerge through coordination
Platform-first: experimentation and product integrity before distribution scale

infrastructure.notes: PNL supports participation and coordination inside the ecosystem. Market activity may exist externally and is independent of platform guarantees or promises.
